title: Arbor Day Celebration and Tree Planting in Gompers Park
description: In celebration of Arbor Day, the City of San Diego hosted a milestone tree planting event at Gompers Neighborhood Park in Chollas View. Sixty-eight trees were planted in the park and in the surrounding neighborhood by the City’s Urban Forestry team, along with City leaders, staff from the Parks and Recreation Department and community volunteers, including students from Millennial Tech Middle School.
